page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Top: running title block and dedication heading centred. Below: body text with a large woodcut initial. Margin notes: none legible beside the text, only ornamental marks at right edge (not text). Page number top right. Signature and catchword at foot.

main_text.head: Illustribus ZELANDIÆ ORDINIBVS, VIRIS AMPLISSIMIS, Dominis Sapientissimis, FRANCISCVS IVNIVS Gratiam & pacem à Domino.
main_text.p: QVVM his paucis diebus, Illustres Ordines, Domini sapientissimi, tristis ille funestusque nuncius adferretur ad nos, de improuisa vicini tractus inundatione, horrui totus animo, iustaque publica rei commiseratione affectus fui grauissimè. Nam sive ad eos

page.notes: The woodcut initial Q is joined to "uvm" as "QVVM" (printed "VVM" after the initial). Lines of the dedication are printed in mixed roman and italic; the italic words are marked. Ornamental marks at right margin are not text. Some words in the body are set in italic with long-s forms; transcribed as plain s. Text is only partly legible in the faint background show-through, which was ignored.
